title: Ramadanid Emirate
capsule: The Ramadanid Emirate (رمضان اوغللري) was a Turkmen dynasty that ruled Cilicia from their capital Adana, founded around 1352 as a client of the Mamluk Sultanate. At their height the Ramadanids controlled the fertile plains between the Taurus Mountains and the Mediterranean, and for a century they balanced between Mamluk suzerainty and the encroaching Ottoman state. After Selim I's conquest of the Mamluks at the Battle of Marj Dabiq (1516), the emirate was absorbed into the Ottoman Empire as a tributary, formally extinguished as an autonomous entity in 1608.
